payload.reason: The evidence provides specific language pairs explored in the context of multilingual neural machine translation (MNMT) and zero-shot translation.

claims.text: The language pairs explored include Arabic (Ar), Spanish (Es), and Russian (Ru), which allow for mutual translation among themselves.
In the Europarl corpus, the language pairs evaluated are French-English-Spanish (Fr-En-Es), German-English-French (De-En-Fr), and Romanian-English-German (Ro-En-De).
The MultiUN corpus involves English (En) as a pivot language with three other languages that do not have parallel data between each other.
